crossRefs.note: To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.
Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also…

translations.web: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
translations.bsb: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
